# `to_xml`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a XML string with a given struct value

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
to_xml(expr[, options])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `xml_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- to_xml, example 1
> SELECT to_xml(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2));
<ROW>
    <a>1</a>
    <b>2</b>
</ROW>
```

```sql
-- to_xml, example 2
> SELECT to_xml(named_struct('time', to_timestamp('2015-08-26', 'yyyy-MM-dd')), map('timestampFormat', 'dd/MM/yyyy'));
<ROW>
    <time>26/08/2015</time>
</ROW>
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
